---
title: "Landscape"
as_of: "2026-10-07"
---

Standing sector map of low-altitude economy businesses: who is doing what in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area and among a few global benchmarks. Industry holds dated news of the same firms; News holds government and regulatory items; Tracker holds official status.

Sources (as of 7 Oct 2026): baseline seed from the landscape packet (LANDSCAPE-2026-10-07, status baseline-seed). Entries are checked against the cited page. Company claims are not treated as fact.

## How to read the tags

Each firm or project carries one source-type tag:

- **Company-announced:** the description comes from the company itself. It is the company's claim, not an established fact.
- **Independently reported:** a news outlet described it from its own sources or checks, beyond the company's statement.
- **Officially confirmed:** a government body or regulator has confirmed the activity in an official release or document, which is linked.

Order values, fleet sizes, delivery counts and launch dates are shown as claimed, with who claimed them. Do not cite this page for official figures; use Tracker.

## How entries appear

Each entry under a sector: firm or project · place, a one-line activity note, then Tag / Status / Source, with a collapsed Chinese or official bilingual box where the source needs one.

## Infrastructure and vertiports

- **Hung Shui Kiu / Ha Tsuen NDA modern logistics cluster (Zone C) · Hong Kong:** Government reserved ~32 ha in HSK/HT NDA for a modern logistics cluster; Zone C focuses on freight forwarding and the low-altitude economy. Planned land / EOI stage — no Hong Kong vertiport statute. [Link](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202608/13/P2026081300409.htm)
  - Tag: Officially confirmed
  - Status: Announced (planned land / EOI; no HK vertiport statute)
  - Source: [GIA English 2026-08-13](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202608/13/P2026081300409.htm) · [GIA Chinese](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202608/13/P2026081300402.htm)

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “To address the logistics industry's long-term demand for logistics sites, the Government has reserved about 32 hectares of land in the HSK/HT NDA for the development of a modern logistics cluster. … Zone C: focuses on freight forwarding and the low-altitude economy;” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202608/13/P2026081300409.htm))

  [「為應付物流業界對物流用地的長遠需要，政府在洪水橋／厦村新發展區內預留約32公頃土地作現代物流圈發展。…區域C：涵蓋貨運代理及低空經濟；」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202608/13/P2026081300402.htm))
  :::

- **Hong Kong Cyberport (Sandbox / UCA trial venue) · Hong Kong:** Venue partner hosting Sandbox / Sandbox X unconventional-aircraft waterfront trials; publishes venue pages and joint press on trial flights. Planned / trial facilities — no Hong Kong vertiport statute. [Link](https://www.cyberport.hk/wp-content/uploads/Press-Release-Cyberport-KC-Smart-Mobility-and-EHang-eVTOL-Inaugural-Test-Flight-Successfully-Completed.pdf)
  - Tag: Company-announced
  - Status: Trial / Sandbox / Sandbox X venue (no HK vertiport statute)
  - Source: [Cyberport press release 2026-08-28](https://www.cyberport.hk/wp-content/uploads/Press-Release-Cyberport-KC-Smart-Mobility-and-EHang-eVTOL-Inaugural-Test-Flight-Successfully-Completed.pdf) · [Cyberport LAE venue page](https://www.cyberport.hk/en/venue-for-the-low-altitude-economy-lae-regulatory-sandbox/)

- **CAD AC-016 (SUA docking-station pathway) · Hong Kong:** CAD Advisory Circular on SUA operations using unmanned aircraft docking stations — guidance for advanced ops permissions. Not a vertiport statute; Hong Kong has no dedicated vertiport ordinance. [Link](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-016.pdf)
  - Tag: Officially confirmed
  - Status: Announced (AC pathway; no HK vertiport statute)
  - Source: [CAD AC-016](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-016.pdf)
